jobs.title: Senior Director, ERP Supply Chain & SAP, Orthopedics
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Director, ERP Supply Chain & SAP, Orthopedics based in Canada .

The Senior Director will provide strategic and operational leadership for enterprise SAP Supply Chain solutions across a complex global technology environment. This role will oversee multiple SAP ECC and S/4HANA instances, guiding critical technology initiatives associated with a major business separation, including Day 1 readiness, transition services, and eventual system consolidation. Working closely with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and IT leaders, the successful candidate will ensure that ERP capabilities support business priorities, regulatory obligations, and operational continuity. The position combines enterprise architecture, large-scale transformation, application delivery, and financial governance with responsibility for a high-performing global organization. It also offers the opportunity to modernize ERP operations through AI, automation, standardization, and continuous improvement.

Accountabilities

Lead the end-to-end strategy, architecture, delivery, and operations of SAP ERP Supply Chain capabilities across multiple SAP ECC and S/4HANA instances, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities.
Oversee SAP systems supporting business separation milestones, including Day 1 readiness, transition activities throughout the Transition Services Agreement (TSA) period, and consolidation into S/4HANA to support TSA exit.
Prioritize regulatory, operational, and strategic initiatives to maximize business value while meeting critical separation and transformation milestones.
Establish and maintain SAP ERP governance frameworks, including architecture standards, investment planning, budgets, and technology operating models.
Manage relationships with SAP providers, system integrators, managed services partners, and strategic technology vendors, overseeing licensing strategies, contracts, and service performance.
Transform and support ERP capabilities across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality, ensuring compliance with business priorities and applicable regulatory requirements.
Drive the adoption of AI and automation to modernize ERP operations at scale, including code remediation, automated testing, and operational efficiency improvements.
Ensure the integrity, security, and regulatory compliance of SAP ERP solutions, including data governance and cybersecurity controls.
Build, develop, and inspire a high-performing global technology organization, bringing together internal teams, onshore and offshore resources, and strategic partners.
Maintain strong financial oversight of technology investments and operating expenditure while promoting continuous improvement, innovation, and standardization across the SAP ecosystem.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related discipline is required. A master's degree, MBA, MS, or equivalent qualification is preferred.
12–14 years of progressive experience planning, designing, delivering, and supporting enterprise SAP business applications.
Extensive experience leading, architecting, and supporting SAP ERP environments, including SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, satellite SAP solutions, and integrations with non-SAP systems.
Demonstrated expertise in SAP application delivery, including development, release and change management, security, archiving, data migration, and landscape coordination.
Proven success leading large-scale global technology programs and complex enterprise transformations, particularly SAP S/4HANA migrations.
Strong knowledge of Supply Chain ERP processes and solutions, including planning, manufacturing, distribution, logistics, and quality management.
Experience working in highly regulated Life Sciences environments, with a solid understanding of compliance, validation, and data integrity requirements.
Demonstrated people leadership capabilities, including building diverse, inclusive, high-performing teams and establishing offshore Global Capability Center (GCC) delivery teams.
Strong strategic thinking, analytical reasoning, fact-based decision-making, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
Experience supporting complex medical device supply chains and manufacturing environments, including specialized processes such as loaner equipment, servicing, and repairs, is preferred.
Experience leading large-scale business separations and divestitures through Day 1 readiness and TSA exit is an advantage.
Experience managing global system integrators and strategic technology vendors, as well as multi-year technology budgets, is preferred.
Change leadership experience in large, matrixed organizations is desirable.
Familiarity with SAP Center of Excellence (COE) platform services is preferred, including BASIS administration, ABAP and SAP IS development, SAP BTP, release and transport management, landscape coordination, security, archiving, and data migration.
English proficiency is required. Certifications in IT, SAP, Supply Chain, or program management, such as PMP or ITIL, are preferred.
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally up to approximately 20% is required.

Benefits

Anticipated annual base salary range of $187,000–$320,850.
Eligibility to participate in a pension plan and a 401(k) savings plan, subject to applicable plan terms.
Eligibility for participation in a long-term incentive program.
Vacation: 120 hours per calendar year.
Sick leave: 40 hours per calendar year, with higher allowances for eligible employees in Colorado and Washington.
Paid holidays: 13 days per calendar year, including floating holidays.
Work, Personal, and Family Time: Up to 40 hours per calendar year.
Parental leave: 480 hours within one year of the birth, adoption, or foster care placement of a child.
Bereavement leave: Up to 240 hours for an immediate family member and 40 hours for an extended family member per calendar year.
Caregiver leave: 80 hours within a rolling 52-week period.
Volunteer leave: 32 hours per calendar year.
Military spouse time off: 80 hours per calendar year.
Fully remote work arrangement, subject to applicable location and employment conditions.
